annotations.title: What ETFIQ published on a date

description: What ETFIQ published on a given date, from its frozen dated archive. Use for a past date, or when a number must stay true after it is quoted: every other tool answers about today. Takes YYYY-MM-DD; covers the pieces written that night, not any per-fund number on any day.

date.description: A day as YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-09-18. A day with no published archive is refused.

name: etfiq_as_of

data.description: The answer; null on a refusal.

error.description: Refusal only: what is not published.
